purpose: Assess robustness of the locked 225-run conclusions after removing label-inconsistent horizontal flipping from OrganSMNIST.
relationship_to_primary_study: The original 225 runs remain immutable and primary. These 75 runs are a post-confirmatory augmentation sensitivity analysis.
held_constant: Backbones, activations, seeds, split, 100-epoch full-train budget, initialization, optimizer, scheduler, normalization, batch size, image size, runtime settings and evaluation are identical to protocol_q2_confirmatory.json.
analysis: Pair every sensitivity run with its original run by model, activation and seed; report original and no-horizontal-flip mean plus sample SD and the paired macro-F1 change with 95% t interval.
claim_boundary: This analysis is explicitly post-confirmatory and descriptive; it does not replace or retroactively modify the locked primary analysis.
